description: Search PuraSIM travel eSIM data plans for a destination (country, region or global), cheapest first. Optional filters on price, data, validity and daily plans. Every plan includes a purasim.com link where the user can buy it.

currency.description: Currency for prices. Checkout may show the shopper's local currency.

destination.description: Country name in any language (e.g. "Japan", "Japón"), ISO 3166 code (e.g. "JP"), region (e.g. "Europe", "Asia", "Balkans", "Global") or a destinationId returned by another tool.

locale.description: Language of the user. Sets the language of the purasim.com pages returned (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, nl, pl, cs, da, no, sv, ro, tr, ar, he, id, ja, ko, th, zh) and of country names.

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in the chosen currency.

minDataGB.description: Minimum total data in GB (for daily plans: GB per day × days).

minValidityDays.description: Minimum validity in days, usually the trip length.

unlimited.description: true: only daily plans, which keep working at reduced speed after the daily allowance. false: only plans with a fixed data total.

name: search_plans
title: Search eSIM plans
